title: GO, tell the good tidings to every one

lines.text: GO, tell the good tidings to every one, That God the Son o'er death prevailed, Gladly and joyfully relay the news To Holy Spirit enthroned.
My King has come, The Conqueror has come, Glory, Honour and power and majesty, To the lamb of God on Throne.
Angelic host offer praises to Jesus Who the universe redeemed Jesus, Holy One, and God Incarnate On earth and Heaven above.
We hallow Bless Sacred King, Majesty Omnipotent Trinity Incomprehensible Almighty God Miraculous Creator.
The wicked, be clouded, ashamed and damned, Who Jesus Lord crucified Evil machinations of the foes is risen Christ Jesus Saviour is risen.
As African Nation of the universe Recognised but all as grass But we have a Father Omnipotent God All our frame and being He knows.
The joy of Resurrection of Jesus We pray thee Lord grant unto us When we shall our earthly toil accomplish Crown of glory to receive.
Glory we offer to the Father show And glory unto the Son Glory we offer unto the Holy Ghost, Praises to the Trinity.
